title: LangSync
description: Break language barriers with automatic real-time chat translation.
body:
> ⚠️ **Privacy Notice:** This plugin sends chat messages to the Google Translate API for translation purposes. No data is stored permanently. 
> # 🌐 LangSync — Real-Time Chat Translation

**LangSync** automatically translates chat messages for every player into their preferred language — **no API key required, completely free.**

Players from different countries can talk freely on the same server without a language barrier.

## ✨ Features

- **Auto-detection** — sets each player's language automatically on first join
- **Per-player translation** — everyone sees chat in their own language at the same time
- **Sign translation** — hold a **Stick**, then **Shift + right-click** any sign to see the translation in chat
- **Multilingual UI** — plugin messages in the player's own language (ru, en, he, de, fr, es, uk)
- **Always works** — if Google Translate is unavailable, switches to backup automatically
- **Lightweight** — no configuration needed, works out of the box

## 💬 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/lang <code>` | Set your language (`ru`, `en`, `he`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `uk`) |
| `/lang list` | Show all supported languages |
| `/lang off` | Disable translation for yourself |
